B.name: Nathan
B.line: Brother of Joel, of the tribe of Judah, numbered among David's mighty men.

why: The Hebrew identifies Joel as “the brother of Nathan” (יוֹאֵל אֲחִי נָתָן), directly matching B’s stated relationship to Joel. The surrounding verses list David’s warriors; nothing here identifies Nathan as Igal’s father or as being from Zobah, as stated for A.
